title: Putting it together
summary: Read a whole phrase before you play it.

steps.title: Read the shape
text: You now have eight notes and three note lengths. As you read, watch the **shape** of the line: does the next note go up, go down, or stay?
A move to the very next line or space is the next letter of the alphabet.

steps.title: Before you play
text: Read this through before you touch the guitar. Name each note and spot the long ones.
Then press **Listen** to check that it sounds the way you expected.

steps.title: First Steps
text: Now play it. Go slowly: steady is better than fast.

steps.title: A new tune
text: A tune you have not seen, with no note names. Read it through first, then play.
